fact: J'aime Ma Langue built a 700-hour Fongbe speech corpus and trained its own recognition, synthesis and translation models in Benin; the first model, trained in July 2026, went into service in August 2026 through one API, with dedicated computing still to be secured.
title: J'aime Ma Langue — Bâtir les infrastructures vocales (bilan, novembre 2026)
